dedupe_keys.name: the effects of earthquake retrofit on the resale value of single family dwellings

description: The Effects of Earthquake Retrofit on the Resale Value of Single-Family Dwellings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jasem Alhumaidi, University of Colorado Boulder (colorado.edu). Seismic retrofits aim to reduce future damage caused by earthquakes, which in turn reduce the cost of rebuilding. This research asks the question: does seismic retrofit affect the resale value of single-family dwellings? Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-tbck-wc43. Keywords: Retrofit, Resale Value, Single-family Dwelling, Earthquake, California. Published 2020-11-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
